name: Blue Earth County, MN
findings: Blue Earth County has 260 nonprofit organizations. 131 of them (50%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 103 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (22% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Blue Earth County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
32% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in Blue Earth County list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.7 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 80 organizations here; 40% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to volunteer so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?

observations.title: Social and fraternal organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 13 social and fraternal organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.

confidence.text: Based on 13 organizations here; 40% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What do social and fraternal organizations here do in the community? How do people find out about them?

observations.title: Few religious organizations list membership
observations.text: 5 religious organizations here list membership. In similar places of this size, about 11 would.

confidence.text: Based on 11 organizations here; 40% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Do people here look for groups to join through religious groups? Where else does that happen?

observations.title: Social and fraternal organizations stand out for volunteering
observations.text: 11 social and fraternal organizations here list volunteering, compared with about 5 in similar places of this size.
